name: sidecar-wake-views-off
description: Wake Island co-op with the server's view switches off: game.serverExternalViews 0, game.serverAllowNoseCam 0, game.serverCrossHairCenterPoint 0. The join's GameRulesEvent (0x16) then carries all three as 0, which the retail client stores at GameClient +0x266 / +0x267 and in the crosshair group's ShowCenterPoint (BF1942.exe 0x004952c0, ledger SESS-1). No bots: a node join reads the event.
human: No client needed: `node sidecar/join.mjs 127.0.0.1:<port> --stay 8 --log run.ndjson` and read the GameRules event.
